<analysis>
Let me chronologically analyze the conversation to capture all important details.

## Session Context
This conversation is a continuation from a previous session that implemented a comprehensive Roles & Permissions feature. The previous session created:
- RoomRoles, ManageRole, RoomPermissions screens
- ChangeMyRoleModal fragment
- Matrix service methods for power levels
- Navigation routes and registrations

## This Session's Work

### 1. ManageRole - Top List Restructuring
User wanted the top list changed to show just avatar + name (max 40px wide) as a horizontal strip.
- Changed from SectionList section to a horizontal ScrollView
- Added `ScrollView` import, removed "top" from sections array
- Each item: `UserImage` (40x40) + truncated name (width: 40, numberOfLines: 1)

### 2. ManageRole - State Reset on Focus
User reported that checked state persisted when navigating between Admins and Moderators screens.
- Added `useFocusEffect` from `@react-navigation/native`
- Resets `pendingPromotions`, `pendingDemotions` on screen focus

### 3. ManageRole - Permission Error for Moderators
User wanted moderators disabled from tapping to manage admins/moderators.
- Added `permissionError` state, `errorTimerRef`, `showPermissionError` callback
- Added `canEdit = myPowerLevel >= 100`
- Showed error banner when moderator taps
Then user said: "remove that message, just make it disabled for the moderator"
- Removed all error state/message code
- Kept `canEdit` logic, set `disabled={!canEdit || isAdmin(item.userId)}` on items

### 4. ManageRole - Moderators can edit moderators list
User clarified moderators CAN edit the moderators list.
- Changed `canEdit = isAdminsScreen ? myPowerLevel >= 100 : myPowerLevel >= 50`

### 5. ManageRole & RoomRoles - Navigation after self-demotion
- If current user is in `pendingDemotions` after save → `navigation.pop(3)` (go to RoomTimeline)
- RoomRoles `handleDemoteMyRole` also uses `navigation.pop(2)`

### 6. RoomPermissions - Disable Admin-level items for moderators
- Added `isItemDisabled = userPowerLevel < 100 && displayLevel >= 100`
- Disabled button + opacity 0.5

### 7. RoomRoles - Gate Permissions section
User said: "Not update the permissions to the the methods in chat rooms (not direct rooms)"
- Added `isDirect: boolean` to `roomRoles` route params
- Passed `isDirect: !!isDirect` from RoomDetails navigation
- In RoomRoles: extracted `isAdmin = userPowerLevel >= 100`, wrapped Permissions section in `{!isDirect && isAdmin && (...)}`

### 8. RoomPermissions fragments extraction
User asked to extract modals into `_fragments` folder.
- Created `src/screens/room-permissions/fragments/utils.ts` (levelLabel, LEVEL_LABELS)
- Created `fragments/PermissionValueModal.tsx`
- Created `fragments/ResetConfirmModal.tsx`
- Created `fragments/index.ts`
- Updated RoomPermissions.tsx to import from fragments, removed local declarations and inline modals
- Note: linter moved files to `permission-value-modal` and `reset-confirm-modal` naming, updated index.ts accordingly
- Also: linter moved `levelLabel` to `shared/utils` as `getLevelLabel`

### 9. RoomMembers - Check invite permission
User asked to check user's power level vs invite threshold.
- Added `canInvite` state
- Added `useEffect` fetching `getRoomPowerLevels(roomId)` → comparing `myLevel >= inviteLevel`
- Conditionally renders invite `+` button only when `canInvite`

### 10. MemberDetailsBottomSheet - Check kick/ban power levels
User asked to check power levels for ban and remove actions.
- Replaced `isAdmin = userPowerLevel === 100` and `isMemberAdmin` with:
  - `kickLevel`, `banLevel` state (default 50)
  - `canRemove = userPowerLevel >= kickLevel && userPowerLevel > memberPowerLevel`
  - `canBan = userPowerLevel >= banLevel && userPowerLevel > memberPowerLevel`
- Fetches kick/ban thresholds from `getRoomPowerLevels` in existing useEffect
- Updated JSX: `canRemove && !isUser && !isBanned` for Remove, `canBan && !isUser && !isBanned` for Ban/Unban

### 11. RoomDetails + EditRoom - Power level checks for edit fields
User asked:
- "update the editRoom in RoomDetails.tsx, edit room can tap either change name, avatar or topic"
- "inside EditRoom.tsx you can change with the correct power level"
- "check the add topic/change topic power level"

**Topic.tsx**: Renamed `isAdmin` prop to `canEdit`

**RoomDetails.tsx**:
- Added `nameLevel`, `avatarLevel`, `topicLevel` state
- Fetches room power levels in existing useEffect
- Computed `canEditName`, `canEditAvatar`, `canEditTopic`, `canEditRoom`
- Edit button: replaced `!isDirect && isAdmin` with `canEditRoom`
- Topic component: `isAdmin={isAdmin}` → `canEdit={canEditTopic}`
- Removed unused `isAdmin` memo

**EditRoom.tsx**:
- Added `userPowerLevel`, `nameLevel`, `avatarLevel`, `topicLevel` state
- `canEditName`, `canEditAvatar`, `canEditTopic` derived values
- Fetches in existing `useEffect` alongside `isDirect`
- Avatar section: `{!isDirect && canEditAvatar && (...)}`
- Name input: `disabled={isDirect || !canEditName}`
- Topic input: `disabled={!canEditTopic}` — this was the last edit made, still pending

Wait, looking at the last tool response - there were no errors after the Topic input edit. The last edit was to the Topic input `disabled` prop. Let me check if there are still remaining edits needed (the `!canEditTopic` on topic input).

The last edit was adding `disabled={!canEditTopic}` to the topic Input. No remaining diagnostics were shown. So EditRoom.tsx should be complete.

Actually wait - the user's last message was the summary request. Before that, the last actual code edit was adding `disabled={isDirect || !canEditName}` to the display name input. But I also need to check if the topic input was updated too. The last Edit tool call was for the display name. The topic input still needs `disabled={!canEditTopic}`.

Actually looking more carefully at the conversation - the last message before the summary request was the diagnostics feedback showing warnings about unused variables in EditRoom.tsx. Then I made 4 edits:
1. Added useEffect fetch
2. Updated avatar section condition
3. Updated display name disabled prop
4. The last edit was for display name - `disabled={isDirect || !canEditName}`

But I see there was one more thing - the topic Input didn't get a `disabled` prop update. Let me check the last code reads/edits...

The last edits shown were:
1. `useEffect` in EditRoom - added power level fetches
2. `{!isDirect && canEditAvatar && (` - avatar section
3. `disabled={isDirect || !canEditName}` - display name

The topic input (`disabled={!canEditTopic}`) appears to be pending but not shown as completed. Actually looking at the sequence again, I may have missed it. The conversation ends with the summary request, so the topic input update may be the pending task.

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   This session continued a React Native Matrix chat app (Cloak and Dagger) Roles & Permissions feature from a previous session. The new requests in this session were:
   - Restructure ManageRole top list to a horizontal strip of avatar + truncated name (max 40px)
   - Reset pending promotion/demotion state when navigating between screens
   - Disable ManageRole items for moderators on the Admins screen (no error message, just disabled)
   - Clarify that moderators CAN edit the Moderators list
   - Navigate to RoomTimeline (pop 3) after self-demotion via ManageRole; same for RoomRoles demote modal
   - Disable Admin-level permission items in RoomPermissions for moderators
   - Gate the Permissions section in RoomRoles to admins only and non-DM rooms (pass `isDirect` param)
   - Extract RoomPermissions modals into a fragments folder
   - Check invite power level in RoomMembers to show/hide the invite button
   - Check kick/ban power levels in MemberDetailsBottomSheet instead of hardcoded `isAdmin`
   - In RoomDetails: show Edit button based on actual name/avatar/topic power levels; check topic edit power level
   - In EditRoom: disable each field (name, avatar, topic) based on individual room power level thresholds

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React Navigation `useFocusEffect` for state reset on screen focus
   - React Navigation `navigation.pop(n)` for skipping multiple screens
   - Matrix room power level thresholds: `kick`, `ban`, `invite`, `roomName`, `roomAvatar`, `roomTopic`
   - `MatrixService.getRoomPowerLevels(roomId)` → `.values()` for thresholds, `.userPowerLevels()` for per-user levels
   - `canEdit = isAdminsScreen ? myPowerLevel >= 100 : myPowerLevel >= 50` — screen-type-aware permission
   - `canRemove/canBan = userPowerLevel >= threshold && userPowerLevel > memberPowerLevel` — prevents acting on equal/higher power users
   - Horizontal `ScrollView` for compact avatar chips in top list
   - Fragment extraction pattern: `fragments/` subfolder with `index.ts` barrel export
   - Shared utils: `getLevelLabel` moved to `shared/utils`
   - `isDirect: boolean` added to `roomRoles` route params for conditional Permissions section

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`src/screens/manage-role/ManageRole.tsx`**
     - Major restructure: top list moved from SectionList section to horizontal ScrollView
     - Added `useFocusEffect` to reset `pendingPromotions`/`pendingDemotions` on focus
     - `canEdit = isAdminsScreen ? myPowerLevel >= 100 : myPowerLevel >= 50`
     - `isDisabled = !canEdit || isAdmin(item.userId)` on section items
     - `navigation.pop(3)` when `wasSelfDemoted` (self-demotion case)
     - Top list renders as: `ScrollView horizontal` with `Block align="center" width={56}` per member (UserImage 40x40 + Text numberOfLines={1} width:40)
     ```tsx
     {topList.length > 0 && (
       <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
         style={styles.topList} contentContainerStyle={styles.topListContent}>
         {topList.map((member) => (
           <Block key={member.userId} align="center" width={56}>
             <UserImage avatarUrl={member.avatarUrl} displayName={member.displayName} width={40} height={40} />
             <Text size={TextSize.tiny} color={Colors.white50} numberOfLines={1} style={styles.topListName}>
               {member.displayName ?? member.userId}
             </Text>
           </Block>
         ))}
       </ScrollView>
     )}
     ```

   - **`src/screens/room-roles/RoomRoles.tsx`**
     - Destructures `isDirect` from route params
     - `const isAdmin = userPowerLevel >= 100`
     - Permissions section wrapped: `{!isDirect && isAdmin && (...)}`
     - `handleDemoteMyRole` uses `navigation.pop(2)` instead of NavigationContainerRef.reset

   - **`src/@types/navigation.d.ts`**
     - `roomRoles` route params now includes `isDirect: boolean`

   - **`src/screens/room-details/RoomDetails.tsx`**
     - Passes `isDirect: !!isDirect` to roomRoles navigation
     - Added `nameLevel`, `avatarLevel`, `topicLevel` state (default 50)
     - Fetches room power levels in existing `useEffect`
     - `canEditName`, `canEditAvatar`, `canEditTopic`, `canEditRoom` memos
     - Edit button: `canEditRoom && (...)` (removed `!isDirect && isAdmin`)
     - Removed unused `isAdmin` memo
     - Topic: `<Topic room={room} topic={roomInfo?.topic} canEdit={canEditTopic} />`

   - **`src/screens/room-details/fragments/topic/Topic.tsx`**
     - Renamed `isAdmin: boolean` prop to `canEdit: boolean`
     - Uses `canEdit` for conditional Add topic button

   - **`src/screens/edit-room/EditRoom.tsx`**
     - Added `userPowerLevel`, `nameLevel`, `avatarLevel`, `topicLevel` state
     - `canEditName`, `canEditAvatar`, `canEditTopic` derived booleans
     - `useEffect` fetches `getUserPowerLevel` and `getRoomPowerLevels`
     - Avatar section: `{!isDirect && canEditAvatar && (...)}`
     - Display name Input: `disabled={isDirect || !canEditName}`
     - Topic Input: `disabled={!canEditTopic}` (last pending edit)

   - **`src/screens/room-permissions/RoomPermissions.tsx`**
     - Imports `PermissionValueModal`, `ResetConfirmModal` from `./fragments`
     - Imports `getLevelLabel` from `shared/utils` (moved by linter)
     - `isItemDisabled = userPowerLevel < 100 && displayLevel >= 100`
     - Inline modals replaced with fragment components

   - **`src/screens/room-permissions/fragments/PermissionValueModal.tsx`** (NEW)
     - Props: `visible`, `selectedLevel`, `availableLevels`, `onSelect`, `onClose`
     - Renamed to `permission-value-modal/` by linter

   - **`src/screens/room-permissions/fragments/ResetConfirmModal.tsx`** (NEW)
     - Props: `visible`, `isResetting`, `onConfirm`, `onClose`
     - Renamed to `reset-confirm-modal/` by linter

   - **`src/screens/room-permissions/fragments/index.ts`**
     - After linter: `export * from "./permission-value-modal"; export * from "./reset-confirm-modal";`

   - **`src/screens/room-members/RoomMembers.tsx`**
     - Added `canInvite` state (default false)
     - `useEffect` fetches `getRoomPowerLevels` → compares `myLevel >= inviteLevel`
     - Invite `+` button in header: `canInvite ? (<Button.Wrapper>...) : undefined`

   - **`src/shared/components/member-details-bottom-sheet/MemberDetailsBottomSheet.tsx`**
     - Removed `isAdmin`, `isMemberAdmin` memos
     - Added `kickLevel` (default 50), `banLevel` (default 50) state
     - `canRemove = userPowerLevel >= kickLevel && userPowerLevel > memberPowerLevel`
     - `canBan = userPowerLevel >= banLevel && userPowerLevel > memberPowerLevel`
     - Fetches kick/ban thresholds in existing `useEffect` via `getRoomPowerLevels`
     - JSX: `{canRemove && !isUser && !isBanned && (...)}` for Remove
     - JSX: `{canBan && !isUser && !isBanned && (...)}` for Ban
     - JSX: `{canBan && !isUser && isBanned && (...)}` for Unban

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **ManageRole: keyExtractor duplication** — Users appeared in both top section and role sections; fixed by section-key prefix in keyExtractor. Later resolved by moving top list to separate ScrollView (no longer in SectionList).
   - **Unused `permissionError`/`errorTimerRef`/`showPermissionError`** — User said remove the error message; removed all related state and just kept `canEdit` for disabling items.
   - **`isAdmin`/`isMemberAdmin` unused in MemberDetailsBottomSheet** — After replacing with `canRemove`/`canBan`, old memos were deleted.
   - **`isAdmin` unused in RoomDetails** — After replacing Edit button and Topic prop, the `isAdmin` memo was removed.
   - **`setNameLevel`/`setAvatarLevel`/`setTopicLevel` unused warnings** — Fixed by adding the `getRoomPowerLevels` fetch in `useEffect`.
   - **Topic prop mismatch `isAdmin` → `canEdit`** — Fixed by renaming in both Topic.tsx interface and RoomDetails usage.
   - **`isDirect` unused in RoomRoles** — Fixed by using it in the `{!isDirect && isAdmin && (...)}` condition.
   - **`canEditRoom` unused** — Fixed by replacing `!isDirect && isAdmin` in GoBackHeader rightComp with `canEditRoom`.
   - **Fragments index linter rename** — Linter renamed files to kebab-case directories; index.ts updated accordingly.

5. Problem Solving:
   - State persistence between ManageRole screens solved via `useFocusEffect` reset
   - Power level enforcement now uses actual room thresholds throughout (invite, kick, ban, roomName, roomAvatar, roomTopic) instead of hardcoded `isAdmin === 100` checks
   - Self-demotion navigation: both ManageRole (pop 3) and RoomRoles demote modal (pop 2) navigate back past intermediate screens
   - Permissions section properly hidden for moderators and DM rooms via `isDirect` param and `isAdmin` check

6. All User Messages:
   - "The top list should be changed, which will be just the image and name with max 40px with name, just so the user knows who that user is"
   - "continue"
   - "Also, the state should not copy, when you go outside the room, you should reset them, because when i go to admin and tap somebody and i go back and go to moderator, the clicked item is still active"
   - "The moderator should not have the option to tap on the members and moderators to make them admins. And also, add the error message to dont display you dont have the permission for that"
   - "remove that message, just make it disabled for the moderator to update admins and moderators and members list"
   - "but moderators can change moderators list"
   - "Also, if you change you state to member either removing the it in the moderator screen, or either demoting to the member, you should go back to the room details screen. Also, in the Permissions, if you are a moderator, and the value is admin, you should not be able to click it."
   - "Not update the permissions to the the methods in chat rooms (not direct rooms). who can invite people, remove, ban, change name, change avatar, change topic, send messages, remove messages"
   - "Extract Modals into _fragments folder in src/screens/room-permissions/RoomPermissions.tsx"
